questionResults.question: Who has seen the most individual birds
questionResults.sql:
SELECT u.username, COUNT(DISTINCT bs.bird_id) AS bird_count
FROM `Bird Sighting` bs
JOIN `users` u ON bs.person_id = u.user_id
GROUP BY u.username
ORDER BY bird_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The person who has seen the most individual birds is Sydney Sky Spotter with 10.

questionResults.question: Who has been a user the longest
questionResults.sql:
SELECT username 
FROM users 
ORDER BY date_Joined 
LIMIT 1;

questionResults.question: What was the common name of the last bird seen by Sydney_sky_spotter
questionResults.sql:
SELECT s.`common name`
FROM `Bird Sighting` bs
JOIN `Bird` b ON bs.`bird_id` = b.`id`
JOIN `Species` s ON b.`Species_id` = s.`Species_id`
JOIN `users` u ON bs.`person_id` = u.`user_id`
WHERE u.`username` = 'Sydney_sky_spotter'
ORDER BY bs.`Sighting date` DESC
LIMIT 1;
